name: Baked Meatballs
description: Wagyu meatballs baked in organic tomato sauce with ricotta and warm bread.
inspiration: Nonna’s Sunday meatballs
pitch: Hearty, saucy comfort food; a great table share, with warm bread to soak up the sauce.

name: Brown Butter Cacio Ravioli
description: Tiny lemon ricotta ravioli in a brown butter cacio e pepe sauce.
inspiration: Roman cacio e pepe, turned into ravioli
pitch: Small, rich and buttery, with a peppery bite and a hint of lemon; a perfect pasta taste.

name: Burrata & Artichokes
description: Creamy burrata and artichokes with roasted garlic and teardrop peppers, mint oil and toasted focaccia.
inspiration: A warm Italian antipasto board
pitch: Cool, creamy and bright; a light, fresh start that is made for sharing with the table.

name: Harissa Carrots
description: Harissa-roasted baby carrots over dill crema with herb salad, pangrattato, grilled orange and Calabrian chili agrumato.
inspiration: North African spice on a Michigan carrot
pitch: Warm and smoky with mild heat, balanced by a cool, herby crema; a lighter share plate.

name: Hot Honey Eggplant
description: Breaded eggplant with pistachio pesto, burrata and pea tendrils, finished with hot honey.
inspiration: Eggplant parm meets Southern hot honey
pitch: Crispy, sweet and a little spicy; the hot honey brings mild heat and the burrata cools it.

name: JB Calamari
description: Chef Jeff’s award-winning calamari topped with tomatoes, scallions and capers in a beurre blanc.
inspiration: Fried calamari meets a piccata-style butter sauce
pitch: Chef Jeff’s award-winning recipe; buttery and bright, with a briny pop from the capers.

name: Prosciutto Fondue
description: Prosciutto di Parma and crusty bread to dip in a truffle fontina-gruyère fondue.
inspiration: Swiss fondue meets an Italian salumi board
pitch: Warm, rich and interactive; dip and share, perfect with a glass of wine before dinner.

name: Scallops Rock
description: Rockefeller-style sweet bay scallops with spinach, prosciutto and Pernod cream, served on the half shell.
inspiration: Oysters Rockefeller, made with bay scallops
pitch: Rich and indulgent on the half shell, with a soft hint of anise; a luxe starter to share.

name: Short Rib Arancini
description: Spheres of saffron risotto filled with shredded short rib and caramelized onion, with Calabrian chili aioli.
inspiration: Sicilian arancini, stuffed with braised short rib
pitch: Crispy outside, creamy inside, with a gentle kick from the chili aioli; easy to share.

name: Tot Oscar
description: Tater tots with hollandaise and butter-roasted crab, finished with caviar and chives.
inspiration: Veal Oscar’s crab and hollandaise, on tater tots
pitch: Fun, decadent and shareable; crispy tots dressed up with crab and caviar.

name: 2 A.M. Pie
description: Prosciutto, mushrooms and Swiss chard over fontina fonduta with mozzarella.
inspiration: A late-night Italian white pie
pitch: A white pie with no red sauce; savory, earthy and rich, the pizza you crave late at night.

name: Cali Margherita Pizza
description: Organic tomato sauce, California tomatoes and stracciatella with sea salt, olive oil and basil.
inspiration: A Neapolitan margherita with California tomatoes
pitch: Light, fresh and simple; a classic margherita, great for guests who want something easy.

name: Double Pepperoni Pizza
description: Two sizes of pepperoni with three cheeses over organic tomato sauce.
inspiration: The classic New York pepperoni slice
pitch: Classic, crowd-pleasing and a little spicy.

name: Mike’s Vegas Winner
description: Guanciale and pickled peaches over garlic butter, with arugula and hot honey.
inspiration: A sweet-and-salty play on prosciutto and melon
pitch: Sweet, salty and a touch spicy; the peaches and hot honey make it our most unexpected pie.

name: Seasonal Veggie Pie
description: Squash purée with eggplant, zucchini, goat cheese and caramelized onion, finished with Thai basil and Calabrian chili oil.
inspiration: A harvest pizza with Southeast Asian accents
pitch: Bright and herby with a little chili heat; a hearty vegetarian pie that changes with the season.

name: Beet Confit
description: Beets over everything-spiced crème fraîche with arugula, orange, pickled shallots and hatch chili almonds.
inspiration: A play on an everything bagel with schmear, built on beets
pitch: Earthy, tangy and crunchy all at once, with a mild chili kick from the almonds.

name: Mushroom Brie Soup
description: Local mushrooms and brie, finished with sourdough croutons.
inspiration: Cream of mushroom soup meets baked brie
pitch: Velvety, rich and comforting; a perfect cold-weather starter with a crunchy finish.

name: Romaine
description: Romaine with Caesar dressing, lemon-garlic pangrattato and pea tendrils.
inspiration: A deconstructed Caesar salad
pitch: Our take on a Caesar; crisp, garlicky and lemony, with a crunchy topping instead of croutons.

name: Second Ave. Salad
description: Butterhead lettuce, tomato, cucumber, green beans and Kalamata olives in a lemon-oregano vinaigrette.
inspiration: A New York Italian-American house salad
pitch: Light, crisp and refreshing; an easy side salad that goes with anything on the menu.

name: Duck Gnocchetti
description: Duck confit with white northern beans and crispy sage and thyme.
inspiration: French cassoulet, reimagined as pasta
pitch: Rustic and hearty, like a French country stew as pasta; savory, herby and perfect for fall.

name: Lobster & Crab Tortellini
description: Fresh crab-ricotta tortellini with butter-roasted lobster and spinach in a fontina fonduta.
inspiration: Lobster mac and cheese, made as tortellini
pitch: Our most indulgent pasta; rich, buttery and cheesy, with sweet lobster in every bite.

name: Rigatoni Ragu
description: Hand-cut mezze rigatoni in a beef ragu with stracciatella and basil pesto.
inspiration: A Bolognese-style ragu with a pesto twist
pitch: Hearty, meaty and comforting; the creamy stracciatella and fresh pesto keep it from feeling heavy.

name: Squash Agnolotti
description: Agnolotti filled with Michigan squash over sweet potato purée, with zucchini and blossoms.
inspiration: Piedmont agnolotti meets a Michigan harvest
pitch: Sweet, earthy and light; a seasonal vegetable pasta that tastes like a Michigan harvest.

name: Sunday Sauce
description: Fresh spaghetti in organic tomato sauce with Locatelli and basil. Make it spicy for 2 or add a meatball for 4.
inspiration: Italian-American Sunday gravy
pitch: Simple, light and kid-friendly; ask for it spicy or add a meatball to make it heartier.

name: Baldwin Burger
description: A grass-fed Fairway Packing burger with butterhead lettuce, paper-thin onions, secret sauce and 7 peppers jam on a brioche bun, with fries.
inspiration: A classic American burger made with Fairway Packing grass-fed beef
pitch: Juicy and messy in the best way; the sweet, peppery jam makes it more than a burger.

name: Braised Short Rib
description: Short ribs braised four hours in red wine, over sweet potato purée and spinach with pan gravy.
inspiration: A classic French red wine braise
pitch: Fall-apart tender after a four-hour braise; deep, rich and comforting on a cold night.

name: Chicken Saltimbocca
description: Crispy chicken cutlet with sautéed prosciutto, spinach and local mushrooms in a beurre blanc, over spaghetti.
inspiration: Roman saltimbocca meets chicken Milanese
pitch: Crispy, salty and savory; a hearty, comforting plate that eats like an Italian classic.

name: Espresso Encrusted Filet Mignon
description: Espresso-crusted filet with mashed potato, asparagus, fennel and zip sauce.
inspiration: A steakhouse filet with a coffee-rub crust
pitch: Our most luxurious steak; tender and rich.

name: Lamb Chops au Poivre
description: Lamb chops in a peppercorn cognac sauce with potato purée, mint salad and pickled scallion bulb.
inspiration: Classic French steak au poivre, made with lamb
pitch: Rich and peppery with a cognac cream sauce; the fresh mint salad lightens every bite.

name: Roasted Chicken
description: Seared airline chicken breast with roasted zucchini, carrots and green beans over roasted red pepper coulis.
inspiration: The classic French roast chicken dinner
pitch: Our lightest entree; simple, juicy and colorful, with plenty of roasted vegetables.

name: Shrimp & Eggplant
description: Seared shrimp and roasted eggplant over brown butter grits with Swiss chard and zip sauce.
inspiration: Southern shrimp and grits with an Italian lean
pitch: Southern comfort with an Italian twist; creamy, buttery grits with a little tang.

name: Sun-Dried Tomato Salmon
description: Seared salmon with sun-dried tomatoes and capers over hand-cut tagliatelle in a Calabrian cream sauce.
inspiration: Salmon piccata over fresh pasta
pitch: Bright and tangy with a creamy, gently spicy sauce; a lighter entree that still feels like a full meal.

name: Cacio E Pepe Fries
description: Fries with fontina fonduta, fresh Parmesan, cracked pepper and lemon zest. Social hour only.
inspiration: Roman cacio e pepe meets loaded fries
pitch: Cheesy and peppery, brightened with lemon; an easy bar snack that goes with any drink.

name: Ham & Cheese
description: Prosciutto and chunks of Parmesan with olive oil, sea salt and bread. Social hour only.
inspiration: The Italian aperitivo plate of prosciutto and Parmigiano
pitch: Simple, salty and classic; the ideal bar snack to share over a glass of wine.

name: Marinated Olives & Nuts
description: House-marinated olives and nuts for the bar. Social hour only.
inspiration: The Italian aperitivo bowl
pitch: Salty, briny and crunchy; a light snack to nibble while you sip.

name: Mushroom Toast
description: Toast with whipped goat cheese and mascarpone, local mushrooms, crispy sage and truffle honey. Social hour only.
inspiration: A cozy play on mushrooms on toast, a fall comfort classic
pitch: Earthy, creamy and a little sweet; cozy fall comfort in a few bites.

name: Steak Frites
description: Sliced sirloin with salsa verde and zip sauce, with fries. Social hour only.
inspiration: The Parisian bistro steak frites
pitch: A full meal at the bar; savory steak with a bright, herby sauce and crispy fries.
